our_interpretation: The claim attributes some difficulty avoiding bias and toxicity to inadequate reference, cognitive models and compositionality. It does not say these are the only causes.
Support requires evidence about that causal connection, rather than evidence that biased or toxic outputs occur.
The relevant systems are the language models discussed in the June 2022 post. Later research may test the proposed mechanism, but later models alone cannot establish its historical importance.
criteria.support_condition: Controlled comparisons show that improving the specified capabilities materially reduces biased and toxic outputs, with competing explanations such as training data and safety fine-tuning addressed.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Well-controlled tests of the specified capabilities show that their inadequacy does not materially contribute to the reported difficulties. Improvement through another intervention alone is insufficient.
